player_prompt.intro: Kuna wasa 2048 a kan {board_size}x{board_size} jirgin. Burin ku shine isa ga tayal {target_tile} ta hanyar zamewa lambobi iri ɗaya tare! Ingantattun motsi: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Tiles sun haɗu lokacin da suka yi karo, suna ninka darajar su.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Aiki mara inganci. Yi amfani da "[Up]"/"[Down]"/"[Left]"/"[Right]".
invalid_move.no_change: Hukumar ba ta canza ba - ta zaɓi wata hanya dabam.

outcome.win: Taya murna, kun isa {target_tile}! Sakamakon ƙarshe {score}.
outcome.lose: Babu sauran motsi Max tile {max_tile} - ƙimar ƙarshe {score}.
